description: This module implements unit and integration of inventory workflows for an e-commerce platform, managing stock reservations, releases, commits upon payment, and refunds with detailed locking and validation to maintain inventory invariants.

classes.name: InventoryActionResult
classes.description: A frozen dataclass representing the result of an inventory operation, indicating if changes occurred and providing a detail message.

methods.name: None _ensure_non_negative(value: int, *, field: str)
methods.description: Utility function to check that a numeric value is non-negative, raises ValidationError otherwise.

methods.name: InventoryActionResult reserve_inventory_for_order( *, order: Order, performed_by=None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Reserves inventory for all items in an order, ensuring stock limits are respected, with idempotency and concurrency control.

methods.name: InventoryActionResult release_inventory_reservations_for_order( *, order: Order, performed_by=None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, reason: str = "Reservation released", )
methods.description: Releases (rolls back) all remaining reservations for an order without affecting stock on hand, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: InventoryActionResult commit_inventory_for_paid_order( *, order: Order, performed_by=None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Converts reserved stock into a completed sale, decreasing both stock reserved and on hand, and records an inventory adjustment.

methods.name: InventoryActionResult restock_inventory_for_order_refund( *, order: Order, performed_by=None, idempotency_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Restocks inventory when an order is refunded, adjusting stock on hand and recording the adjustment for audit.
